title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
slides: Can Deezer tell human music from AI?
It will filter AI-generated tracks from recommendations
But detection tools still fail on hybrid songs
Your playlists may change without warning
Check your Release Radar next week
thread_text:
1. Your playlist just changed

Deezer is now filtering AI-generated tracks from recommendations. No warning, no label — the song simply disappears from your queue.

2. The hybrid problem

Detection tools still fail on songs that mix human and AI parts. A track can pass as fully human while half of it was generated.

3. How they spot AI

Deezer analyzes audio patterns and metadata, but the system learns from what it catches. New AI models slip through every week.

4. Silent removals

Your Release Radar may lose tracks next week without explanation. Artists affected won't be notified — only you notice the gap.

5. Check your Radar

Open your Release Radar next week. If a song you expected is missing, ask why. That silence is the new detection signal.

instagram.caption:
Your Release Radar might lose songs next week without any warning or explanation.

Deezer is starting to filter AI-generated tracks out of its recommendations. If a song gets flagged, it just disappears from your queue. No label, no notification. 🎧

The system scans audio patterns and metadata, but it still fails on hybrid tracks — songs that mix human and AI parts can pass as fully human. 🤖

If you're an artist, part of your catalog could vanish from playlists with no notice. 🔍

Open your Release Radar next week. If something you expected is missing, that silence is the signal. What would you do if your own track got filtered? 🎵
